digest.component_or_area: lifecycle policy enforcement for rebar project
propositions: Enable material-pin and plan-review close enforcement in rebar without eager backfill or stored relation migration, while library defaults remain false
Prove through end-to-end public lifecycle tests that direct and transitive invalidation occurs only after actual narrow material changes, not on unrelated modifications
Verify that depends_on and inbound blocks references normalize to a single canonical prerequisite pin/evaluation without duplicate enforcement or redundant propagation
Demonstrate that an unchanged successful re-review produces no further downstream invalidation or propagation
Prove through real CLI execution that stale material-pin drift rejects claim/close with proper exit codes and naming of the canonical stale target
Verify that missing or phase-incompatible close-plan review rejects close transitions while leaving status unchanged and instructing the operator to run review-plan
